releases.name: Florana Defense
releases.summary: Incremental Mazing Tower Defense. No lives, just make more gold. No fixed mob path, create the best maze ever.

releases.name: Grave digging for wealth
releases.summary: 这款盗墓游戏以二十世纪初军阀混战为背景。玩家扮演盗墓贼，四个门派分支可选，寻找情报定位古墓位置、挖掘盗洞规避机关陷阱、消灭僵尸和怪物摸金撤离。搜寻宝物，揭开尘封的秘密。规划物资（食物、工具、道具）在危机四伏的地下，与生死之间探寻真相。

releases.name: BomberParty
releases.summary: "This is the best game ever! I just bought it and I can not stop playing it." - Ponyexpress"This is a really fun game and I'm totally addicted! This is the best game ever! I absolutely love it!" - keeblerponyYou'll get a lot of enjoyment out of playing this ground-breaking racing game and you'll get a chance to race your horses against the world! FEATURESRealtime 3D Graphics.Virtual 3D Sound System.Simple to Play.Straight Bets (Win/Place/Show).Horse details with unique ability.Up to 8 runners per race.Preview horses/jockeys before betting.

releases.name: Bearly Awesome: Chapter 1
releases.summary: Check out this FUN and addictive military hero running game!Join war hero soldier as he dodges obstacles in the war zone. See how far you can go and be all that you can be!Try it out today!

releases.name: SPEED: 8.X
releases.summary: Help the super bunny Joe to collect all the Golden Eggs!Dodge the thorns, stay alert to the evil turtles, run throught the fields, eat as many carrots as you can, and guide our hero in this adventure!

releases.name: Love Nest ~V0.098~
releases.summary: Are you a trivia fanatic, obsessed with knowing amazing, obscure facts about everything from science to movies, from sports to the latest global news? Then step right up- General Knowledge Trivia tests your true intelligence and brain power with never-ending questions on every subject matter in the world: current events, science, sports, movies, music, history, geography, and more! Become a true trivia genius! Game Features: *Thousands of questions on every subject matter! *Questions ranging from easy, medium, and hard *Save your score to try to save your own personal record *Show off by posting your best score on social media sites (Facebook and Twitter) *Invite friends to play!

releases.name: Pawmlet - Wheat Farm
releases.summary: Want a Word Game with the excitement of Casino Slots!Jackpot Words is a totally new spin on your favorite Word game.• No Ads• Comes with 1000 gems• Win jackpots as you create words• Unlock special mini-games and treasures• Earn bigger rewards with each new level• Play by yourself or compete with friendsCreate the right word combos and win huge payouts.The more coins you win, the higher you rise!You've never had so much fun playing a word game before!

releases.name: Tomboy Adventure 2
releases.summary: Start a relaxing summer adventure together with your (girl) friend!

releases.name: Lunar Drifter
releases.summary: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 15 unique hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!

releases.name: Lobstar: Arcade Version
releases.summary: Punch through the cosmos! An arcade-inspired shoot-em-up where you play as an immortal lobster speeding through space.

releases.name: Decklings
releases.summary: Tame magical creatures called Decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this resource management, deckbuilding card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft items to build your base and raise your Decklings as you shape your path to become the Deckling Champion.

releases.name: Tower of Pestilence
releases.summary: In this bullet-heaven with a fanciful and monstrous art style, explore a dungeon where vampiric creatures and pestilence demons coexist. Play as adventurers with simple controls, improve your gear, and survive the hordes lurking in the tower !

releases.name: Card Conquest
releases.summary: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

releases.name: GLUE BLOCKS
releases.summary: Glue falling blocks together to make clear massive lines! Survive wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity to a retro-inspired soundtrack. Play solo, local versus, or in hilarious online co-op in the same well with friends!

releases.name: Woman Simulator
releases.summary: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

releases.name: Oh Ship!
releases.summary: Oh Ship! is a 1–4 player co-op space survival game where you and your crew coordinate to keep your ship running while space actively tries to destroy it. Salvage wrecks, fix systems, upgrade your ship, and survive the chaos.

releases.name: Stranded with You
releases.summary: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

releases.name: Tethered To You
releases.summary: After you are unable to find a patron to provide you with a magic bond, you stumble into the abandoned temple of the Passion goddess - with four patrons waiting for you. Yet, as you grow closer to gaining magic, something else is drawn to this power...
